project_type: Laravel 12 + Inertia/Vue 3 (PrimeVue/Sakai, Tailwind 4) dengan Vite; SSE notifikasi lewat Redis Pub/Sub (phpredis) di php-fpm + nginx
build_system: composer (PHP), npm + vite (frontend, `npm run build`). Docker: prod = docker-compose.yml (docker/php/Dockerfile, docker/nginx/Dockerfile; MySQL & Redis di host Linux); dev = docker-compose.dev.yml (docker/php/Dockerfile.dev, bind mount `.:/var/www`, nginx image stock memakai bind mount docker/nginx/default.conf, Redis/MySQL container, port 8085). Tidak ada .dockerignore saat ini.
test_framework: PHPUnit via `php artisan test` (phpunit.xml: sqlite :memory:, suite Unit & Feature). Tidak ada framework tes JS (package.json hanya vite) -> JANGAN menambah dependensi.
test_command: php artisan test  (lokal Windows php 8.3 TANPA ekstensi redis/pcntl); di container: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app php artisan test
verification_instructions: Lihat plan-final.md bagian 3 (tes) dan 4 (verifikasi Docker). FEAT-001: `php artisan test --filter=Notification`, lalu `php artisan test`, lalu `npm run build`. FEAT-002: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml config -q`, `docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml config -q`, tinjau .dockerignore terhadap daftar file yang dibutuhkan build. Rebuild nyata & e2e dikerjakan langkah docker-verify.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/build/ (hasil `npm run build`, di-gitignore). public/hot ada di working dir (dev server) dan TIDAK boleh masuk image. Tidak ada snapshot yang di-commit.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. TIDAK ada worktree: kerja langsung di f:\LARAVEL\remunisasi_v2. JANGAN git commit/push. JANGAN membaca atau menampilkan nilai .env (rahasia). Stack dev proyek `remunisasi_v2` sedang jalan (sakai_*_dev, port 8085/5173/9000/3307/6380) -- boleh di-rebuild tapi JANGAN `down -v`. Stack lain di mesin (pqms-*, sikep_v2-*, simrs_profile_app) JANGAN disentuh. Port 8000 dipakai Apache host; verifikasi build prod pakai `-p rtprodtest` dan APP_PORT=8091.
contribution_requirements: Komentar/docblock/README dalam Bahasa Indonesia, gaya sama dengan berkas yang ada. Perubahan minimal; jangan menambah fitur di luar plan-final.md. Tes baru bergaya tests/Feature/NotificationTest.php (RefreshDatabase, helper mockRole/actingAsKabid).
key_patterns: Callback Pub/Sub Laravel: PhpRedisConnection::subscribe() memanggil $callback($message, $channel) (vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/Redis/Connections/PhpRedisConnection.php:458-463). Koneksi Redis `notifications` (prefix kosong, DB 2) di config/database.php; channel `notif.user.{sikep_user_id}`. NotificationService::notify() = persist baris (App\Models\DatabaseNotification, created_at mikrodetik, dateFormat 'Y-m-d H:i:s.u') lalu publish best-effort. Sinyal: {id,type,message,url,task_id,created_at}. Frontend: singleton EventSource di composables/useNotifications.js; AppLayout.vue memanggil init(). Exception di dalam callback phpredis muncul sebagai getPrevious() dari \RedisException.
directory_structure: app/ (Http/Controllers, Services, Models), config/, resources/js (app.js, composables/, Pages/, Layouts/), routes/web.php (SSE route notifications.stream di grup auth,active-role,two-factor), tests/Feature, docker/{php,nginx}, storage/ (kerangka framework/cache,sessions,views), .agents/tasks/<task>/ (artefak, JANGAN di-commit).
